JudgeSpec.description:
The study's shared judge: an Anthropic Messages API call on the user's own key.

Every field is part of the study configuration and so of its
pre-registration hash; a judge cannot be re-tuned after registration
without the hashes changing.

temperature.description: Sampling temperature sent with each judge call; None sends none. Current Claude models reject the parameter, so it is only for older models that accept it.
temperature.title: Temperature

max_tokens.description: Output cap of one judge call.
max_tokens.title: Max Tokens

thinking.description: 'disabled' asks for a single pass with no extended thinking; 'model_default' sends nothing and lets the model decide (needed for models that refuse 'disabled').
thinking.title: Thinking

JudgeSpec.title: JudgeSpec

description: The judge settings to try and the key to try them with (used once, never kept).
title: JudgeCheckRequest
